_rules.top_level: icon + label; active = filled icon and bold label
_rules.group: label + chevron; expanded = chevron up; a collapsed group containing the active leaf keeps its label bold
_rules.leaf: label only; active = 12px-radius pill #E5E7EB, bold label
_rules.connector: a bracket from the group down to the active leaf appears when the active leaf is the first child of an expanded group; behaviour for a non-first active child not yet observed
_rules.default_open: the first child in order: a leaf is selected, a group is expanded and its first leaf selected (Integrations → Verification levels → Individual levels; Settings → Team → Members). Case management and Dev space start on the leaf Overview — assumed from order, not observed
_rules.dynamic: Integrations → Global settings: its leaves depend on which verification levels the client has configured
_rules.hidden: hidden:true — not rendered by default; menu.items (a whitelist) can still name the item. Kept so the data and icons survive until the layout changes again
